AiProviders.title: AI Provider Keys
AiProviders.description: Connect your organization's own keys. Imagine AI calls the provider with your key, and the provider bills usage to your account. Keys are encrypted at rest and never shown again after saving.

keys.q: Do I need my own AI key?
keys.a: Yes. To generate anything, an org admin connects a key from OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, OpenRouter, BytePlus or Kling in Settings → API Keys. Video needs a Gemini key with video access, a BytePlus key or a Kling key.

credits.a: Credits are your plan's monthly quota of jobs, not money. Each tool uses a set number of credits per job, and video depends on length and resolution. Failed jobs cost nothing.

cost.q: What will AI usage cost me?
cost.a: Your provider bills you directly at its own prices. Imagine AI shows an estimate only and adds no markup.

video.a: Video is on paid plans. Each plan has a storage limit and keeps clips for a set time, shown on its card. Older clips are removed automatically, so download anything you need to keep.

cancel.a: Yes. Your plan stays active until the end of the paid period, then the workspace moves to Free.
